description: Create a media record and a signed Supabase Storage URL that the client uploads raw bytes to with an HTTP PUT. Works only for clients with direct network access to Supabase storage, such as Claude Code or a local CLI. Browser-sandboxed chat clients (ChatGPT, Claude.ai) block that network egress, so the hosted server hides this tool from them; aidelly_upload_media uploads server-side instead. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_media_upload_url
title: Create Media Upload Url
